diagnosis: v6 booked 9/9 (invoices 61, 63-70). Every run followed the same 15-step path with wasted=0, and no step had screen_changed=False. Nothing is broken, so the procedure stays.

Both v6 reflexes fired identically in all 9 runs. '+ Add Row' after type_date (step 6) always produced the 'X Item' row at y≈472 (S7, S21, S34...). 'Save' after type_amount (step 12) always produced the popup 'Create new Purchase Invoice entry?' (S13, S27...).

Two v6 hints went over the 300-character limit and were cut off mid-sentence: 'Only if NO row exists at y≈472, c' and 'all equal to the invoice amount, cl'. Jev has been reading broken fallback instructions. They never mattered only because the fallback was never needed.

Jev's lowest confidence is the date click at step 4 (0.65-0.83, runner_up scroll_up, scroll_down or type_date). On that screen the supplier's leftover dropdown (name + 'Create' at y≈262-296) hides the 'Date' label (S3, S17, S30). The click was right every time, but this is the weakest decision.

Time is 30 s per invoice for 15 steps, about 2 s per step, and roughly half of that is settle time. Every screen was fully drawn at 1.0 s. Reflex clicks hit fixed positions ('+ Add Row' 641,473; 'Save' 1302,67), so they tolerate a shorter settle.

Risk to respect when cutting settle: the supplier and item dropdowns must finish filtering before the reflex Return (S2 still shows the full unfiltered supplier list right after the click). Settle after type_supplier and type_item therefore stays at 1.0.
Invoice 62 (WellyBox, ILS) took 0 steps and booked no row, yet was counted as a success. The engine handled it, and the read was correct (ILS, 258.42). No playbook change is needed.

I am not adding a 'Yes' or 'Submit' reflex. It would have to key on click_item and so fire after every click, including on the 'Grand Total $0.00' warning popup. The log does not show what happens when the reflex text is missing from the screen.
